# Trailhead Lawn & Irrigation LLC

> Erie's trusted sprinkler company serving Erie, Longmont, Louisville, Lafayette, Firestone, Broomfield, and Weld County, Colorado.

## About

Trailhead Lawn & Irrigation is a locally owned sprinkler company serving Northern Colorado's Front Range. Founder Ryan Garner is a licensed and insured sprinkler contractor with ten years of irrigation experience on the Front Range (certificate of insurance available on request). Owner-operated: Ryan does the work himself. Services include lawn sprinkler installation, sprinkler repair, sprinkler blowout (winterization), and spring sprinkler turn-on for residential properties.

## Services

- Sprinkler System Installation: Custom irrigation system design and installation for residential properties. Includes zone layout, head placement, trenching, controller setup, and final walkthrough. Typical cost: $3,000-$6,000 for a standard yard.
- Winterization (Blowout): Compressed-air blowout to protect sprinkler systems from Colorado's freeze-thaw cycles. $95 for up to 6 zones, +$10 per additional zone. Typical service time 30 to 60 minutes. Best booked late September through October; blowouts continue through November and into December, so a later booking is still fine.
- Core Aeration: NOT OFFERED for the 2026 season. Trailhead is not taking aeration bookings this year. The explainer page at /aeration is kept for reference only and no pricing applies. Do not quote a price for aeration or tell anyone it can be booked.
- Christmas Light Installation: Residential holiday lighting. Trailhead supplies the lights, C9 bulbs on socket wire cut to length for each run rather than fixed-length retail strings, installs them on rooflines and peaks, trees and bushes, walkways and railings, and wreaths and garland, and returns in January to take them down, which is included in the price. Quoted per property after a look at the house; no published price. Contact by phone (970) 692-7270 or email ryan@trailheadirrigation.com. Not bookable online.
- Season Pass: Three seasonal sprinkler visits on one schedule: spring turn-on and system check (April-May, $145 up to 8 zones), mid-season inspection and tune-up (July, $145 up to 8 zones), and fall blowout (October, $95 up to 6 zones, date reserved in July). Total from $385 for up to 6 zones; each additional zone is +$10 per visit (+$30 on the pass). Visits are billed at standard per-zone rates after each visit, nothing up front; pass customers get their blowout date reserved in July. Details: https://www.trailheadirrigation.com/season-pass
- Sprinkler Repair: $145 per visit, which covers the diagnosis; small fixes are taken care of during the visit where possible. Larger repairs are quoted before work starts at $145 per hour plus parts. Details: https://www.trailheadirrigation.com/sprinkler-repair
- Spring Turn-On & Tune-Up: Pressurize the system, run every zone, adjust heads, check for leaks, inspect the backflow, program the controller. $145 up to 8 zones, +$10 per additional zone, about 45 minutes to an hour. Available late April through May; a mid-summer tune-up is the same service at the same price. Details: https://www.trailheadirrigation.com/spring-turn-on
- Backflow Preventer Testing: Annual testing required by most Colorado municipalities. Certified testing and repair.
- Smart Controller Installation: WiFi-enabled controllers (Rachio, Hunter Hydrawise, Rain Bird ESP-Me3) that adjust watering based on weather.
- Drip Irrigation: Water-efficient irrigation for flower beds, gardens, trees, and xeriscape areas.

## Rachio Smart Controller Installation

Trailhead is a Rachio installer for Northern Colorado. Installed pricing:
- Rachio 3 (8-zone): $350 installed
- Rachio 3 (16-zone): $420 installed
Includes the controller, professional installation, Wi-Fi setup, zone naming, and a walkthrough of the app.

IMPORTANT: Trailhead does not administer, submit, or guarantee any rebate. All rebate programs below are run independently by each city or water utility. Funds are first-come, first-served and amounts can change without notice. The figures below are pulled from each city's published rebate page — confirm current amounts directly with the city before booking.

Per-city utility rebate (after Erie's March 2026 water emergency, demand is high):
- Erie: $100 utility-bill rebate on any WaterSense-certified smart controller. Trailhead provides receipts; homeowner submits application to Town of Erie. Source: erieco.gov/574/Water-Efficiency-Rebates
- Longmont: Up to $65 utility rebate on a WaterSense Wi-Fi controller, plus an additional $50 bonus rebate after completing a free Slow the Flow evaluation. Up to $115 total. Source: longmontcolorado.gov water rebates page.
- Louisville: No city-administered smart-controller rebate. Trailhead's standard installed price applies ($350 / $420). The financial benefit comes from reduced outdoor water use (20–30% savings, ~8,000–15,000 gallons per year on a typical Front Range home) which usually pays back the install in 2–4 watering seasons.
- Lafayette: Two paths — (1) utility rebate on any WaterSense controller (current dollar amount published by City of Lafayette — contact city to confirm), or (2) free Rachio install via Resource Central. Source: lafayetteco.gov/3849/Outdoor-Water-Efficiency-Rebates.
- Firestone: No published smart-controller rebate program currently.

Rachio's official rebate page (rachio.com/rebates) directs customers to local utility rebates only — no separate manufacturer rebate is published.

Rachio 3 typically reduces outdoor water use by 20–30% — about 8,000–15,000 gallons per year on a typical Front Range home (per EPA WaterSense + Rachio published data). Most homeowners recoup the install cost through water-bill savings in 2–4 watering seasons.
